_comment: Keys the demo phone owns, and the ONLY keys truncate_statements.js will ever
delete from. Everything else in these stores belongs to a real person and
deletion cannot be undone, so this file is the safety allowlist -- a token
not listed here is refused before a connection is even opened.
PUBLIC TOKENS ONLY. The private keys are not in this repository and must not
be: it is public, and whoever holds one can sign as that identity. The demo
600, and goes back onto a phone through the app's IMPORT screen.
A token is the SHA1 of the pretty-printed (2-space indent) canonical public
key JSON -- not the compact form, which produces a token matching nothing.
